stem:
Wafa must bisect $\angle RST$ with ruler and compass.

Which construction is correct?

options.text: Mark $A$ and $B$ on the arms with $SA = SB$, then choose $C$ so that $AC = BC$, and draw ray $SC$.
Name the vertex $S$ as the bisector, and treat equal arm marks as unnecessary.
Draw any ray from $S$ through the printed middle of $\angle RST$ with no equal marks.
Mark equal lengths on one arm only, then declare that single arm to be the bisector.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal marks SA=SB on the arms and AC=BC build congruent triangles so ray SC bisects ∠RST. B labels the vertex as the bisector. C follows a printed middle with no equal marks. D marks only one arm.
